import h5py, scipy.sparse as sp, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from collections import defaultdict
np.random.seed(0)

def load(fn):
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        n_obs,n_var=f['X'].attrs['shape']
        X=sp.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][:], f['X/indices'][:], f['X/indptr'][:]), shape=(n_obs,n_var)).tocsr()
        gcats=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else x for x in f['obs/guide/categories'][:]]
        gc=f['obs/guide/codes'][:]
        guides=np.array([gcats[i] for i in gc])
        var=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else x for x in f['var/_index'][:]]
        target=None
        if 'obs/target_gene' in f:
            tcats=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else x for x in f['obs/target_gene/categories'][:]]
            tc=f['obs/target_gene/codes'][:]
            target=np.array([tcats[i] for i in tc])
        return X,guides,var,target

ref,ref_guides,var,ref_target=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
query,q_guides,var2,_=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
assert var==var2

# basic filter
gene_sums_ref=np.asarray(ref.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
gene_sums_q=np.asarray(query.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
keep=(gene_sums_ref>0)&(gene_sums_q>0)
print('genes expressed both', keep.sum())
ref=ref[:,keep]; query=query[:,keep]; var=np.array(var)[keep]
# further filter genes total > 20 maybe
gene_tot=gene_sums_ref[keep]+gene_sums_q[keep]
keep2=gene_tot>20
print('genes >20',keep2.sum())
ref=ref[:,keep2]; query=query[:,keep2]; var=var[keep2]

def lognorm(X, scale=1e4):
    X=X.astype(np.float64).tocsr()
    lib=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    lib[lib==0]=1
    X=X.multiply(1.0/lib[:,None]).tocsr()
    X.data=np.log1p(X.data*scale)
    return X.tocsr()

ref_n=lognorm(ref); q_n=lognorm(query)
# pseudo bulk means
def guide_means(Xn, guides):
    cats=sorted(set(guides))
    M=np.zeros((len(cats), Xn.shape[1]))
    for i,g in enumerate(cats):
        idx=np.where(guides==g)[0]
        M[i]=np.asarray(Xn[idx].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    return cats,M
rcats,refM=guide_means(ref_n,ref_guides)
qcats,qM=guide_means(q_n,q_guides)
# NT masks
r_nt=[g for g in rcats if g.startswith('NT-')]
q_nt=[g for g in qcats if g.startswith('NT-')]
r_nt_mean=refM[[rcats.index(g) for g in r_nt]].mean(axis=0)
q_nt_mean=qM[[qcats.index(g) for g in q_nt]].mean(axis=0)
# signatures
rsig={}; qsig={}
for i,g in enumerate(rcats):
    if not g.startswith('NT-'):
        rsig[g]=refM[i]-r_nt_mean
for i,g in enumerate(qcats):
    if not g.startswith('NT-'):
        qsig[g]=qM[i]-q_nt_mean
# correlations spearman
rows=[]
for qg,qv in qsig.items():
    best=[]; 
    for rg,rv in rsig.items():
        corr=spearmanr(qv,rv).correlation
        best.append((corr,rg))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    rows.append((qg,[(rg,round(c,4)) for c,rg in best[:5]]))
for qg,b in rows:
    print(qg, b)
print('\\nTop corr assignment for each query guide:')
for qg,b in rows:
    print(qg, '->', b[0])
# Also show for ref targets PABPC1,NUDT21,LEO1 their closest query guides
for t in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2']:
    print('\\nREF target',t,'closest query:')
    arr=sorted([(spearmanr(rsig[t],qv).correlation,qg) for qg,qv in qsig.items()], reverse=True)
    print(arr[:10])

# quick marker for SCAF8 and CPSF3L, CPSF1 etc
import h5py, scipy.sparse as sp, numpy as np, re, warnings
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
files=['perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad','perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad']; out=[]
for fn in files:
 with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
  n_obs,n_var=f['X'].attrs['shape']
  X=sp.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][:], f['X/indices'][:], f['X/indptr'][:]), shape=(n_obs,n_var)).tocsr()
  gcats=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else x for x in f['obs/guide/categories'][:]]
  gc=f['obs/guide/codes'][:]
  g=np.array([gcats[i] for i in gc]); var=[x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else x for x in f['var/_index'][:]]
  out.append((X,g,var))
X1,g1,v1=out[0]; X2,g2,v2=out[1]
common=[x for x in v1 if x in set(v2)]
X1=X1[:,[v1.index(x) for x in common]].astype(float).tocsr(); X2=X2[:,[v2.index(x) for x in common]].astype(float).tocsr()
for X in [X1,X2]:
 lib=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel(); lib[lib==0]=1; X=X.multiply(1.0/lib[:,None]).tocsr(); X.data=np.log1p(X.data*1e4)
nt1=np.char.startswith(g1.astype(str),'NT-'); nt2=np.char.startswith(g2.astype(str),'NT-')
mu1=np.asarray(X1[nt1].mean(0)).ravel(); mu2=np.asarray(X2[nt2].mean(0)).ravel()
def sigs(X,g,mu):
 return {gg:np.asarray(X[g==gg].mean(0)).ravel()-mu for gg in set(g) if not gg.startswith('NT-')}
rs=sigs(X1,g1,mu1); qs=sigs(X2,g2,mu2)
for tg in ['SCAF8-I3','CPSF3L-I8','CPSF1-I3','LEO1-I2']:
 print('\\n',tg)
 order=np.argsort(-np.abs(rs[tg]))[:100]
 vals=[]
 for q in qs:
  vals.append((pearsonr(qs[q][order],rs[tg][order])[0],q))
 for c,q in sorted(vals,reverse=True)[:10]:
  print(q,round(c,3),'count',(g2==q).sum())
PY"
